The Story

Started with a full creative testing phase across all available assets. Ran 3 Ad Sets simultaneously — scaled winners, paused underperformers, and kept a close eye on any creative showing strong early signals even before the numbers fully confirmed it. The client had worked with multiple agencies before and had never seen results like this. Most importantly, the messages coming in were actual reservations — not just inquiries.

"Finally, people are booking — not just asking." — Client feedback

02 — Restaurant · Meta Ads

CPO Winner Eid Campaign — Scaling Phase

CPO + Scaling

Cost per Message

The Story

After identifying winners from the testing phase, moved them into a dedicated CPO campaign with minimum spend limits per Ad Set — ensuring each creative got proper budget allocation. Daily budget: 1,500 EGP. The campaign performed well overall, but one Ad Set showed diminishing quality when budget increased, widening the audience beyond the ideal target. Stopped it immediately to protect lead quality.

True scaling isn't just increasing budget — it's knowing when to stop.

The Story

Client came in with 800 EGP and a creative he'd already prepared — with one request: "Launch a campaign for the Arsenal vs PSG match today." I looked at the creative and was direct: it wouldn't grab attention. Proposed running 2 creatives across 2 Ad Sets to maximize the tight budget and timeline. Designed a new creative from scratch. We launched at 5 AM. The match kicked off at 7 PM. My creative won — delivering messages at 8 EGP each.

Launched at 5AM, match at 7PM — speed and strategy combined.

The Story

Took the winning creative from the original testing campaign and launched a dedicated scaling campaign. Early results showed a high CPM — the client pushed to stop it. I disagreed. Looking beyond the surface metric, the CTR, CPC, and CPM were all strong signals of a healthy creative. The algorithm just needed time to optimize. We held. The cost per message dropped from 35 EGP to 16 EGP — and it's still falling. Projected to become the best-performing campaign in this account.

A real performance marketer reads all the metrics — not just the one that looks bad.

The Story

An accessories e-commerce brand came in with a ROAS stuck at 2x at best — and declining. First step was diagnosing the real problem: website issues were killing conversions before the ads even had a chance. After fixing the technical problems on-site, launched a structured creative testing framework. Identified winners fast, scaled them aggressively, and cut losers immediately. The result: ROAS tripled and revenue hit 215,000+ EGP.

The problem wasn't the ads — it was the website. Diagnosis before execution.

07 — Food Court · Meta Ads

Egypt vs Australia Match Event — Full House

Event Marketing · 4 EGP/msg
490
Conversations
4 EGP
Cost per Message
7.08%
CTR
Full
Venue Capacity

The Story

A food court venue with 200 seated capacity needed to fill up for the Egypt vs Australia match. The challenge: a large space, a specific event, and a tight window to fill it. I requested specific creatives based on experience — knowing what kind of content would resonate for a live match event. Tested a photo and a video. The photo delivered at ~6 EGP per message; the video showed 12 EGP — but I didn't stop the video. Its CTR was exceptionally high, signaling strong audience interest. Scaled both into a new campaign. The cost per message dropped to 4 EGP, and the messages coming in were high quality — the venue filled to capacity.

CTR told me to keep the video. The data was right — venue sold out.
